rows.text: Incoming inspection commission assigned by order:  NIKIMT-Atomstroy JSC № 39-300/23-P Dated: 30-05-2022
The Commission have issued this Incoming Inspection Certificate of Materials for the Materials as follows:
Type, brand, standard (technical requirement, GOST, etc.)
Name and number of the document that certifies quality:
2. As a result of inspection were revealed following:

2.1 Remarks for accompanying documents (none, or give comments): The submitted quality documents are not properly certified, there are no translations into English. Certificates No. 4010283971, No. 4010283972 dated 29.09.2023 and No. 4010279290 dated 04.09.2023, No. 4010284388 dated 01.10.2023 have incomprehensible marks in the column "Net weight". In the packing list No. 2929-01/2024 dated 29.01.2024 the marking of the delivered sheet and its steel grade are different from the agreed and actually delivered (instead of B-PN-NO, St3Sp5 it is B-PN-O, C245). / Предоставленные документы о качестве не заверены должным образом, отсутствуют переводы на английский язык. Сертификаты № 4010283971, № 4010283972 от 29.09.2023 и № 4010279290 от 04.09.2023, № 4010284388 от 01.10.2023 имеют непонятные отметки в графе "Масса нетто". В упаковочном листе № 2929-01/2024 от 29.01.2024г. маркировка поставленного листа и его марка стали отличны от согласованной и фактически поставленной (вместо Б-ПН-НО, Ст3Сп5 указано Б-ПН-О, С245).
2.2. Remarks for visual, measurement and other inspections including Material’s completeness (none, or give comments): NONE
2.3. Remarks for preservation and/or anticorrosive coating (none, or give comments): NONE
2.4. Non-conformities (none, or give comments, Non-conformity report no.): NONE
